title: Special repairs and maintenance of Lighthouse Tower and compound wall etc. at Minicoy North Lighthouse
summary: Special repairs and maintenance of the lighthouse tower, compound wall and related structures at Minicoy North Lighthouse, Minicoy Island, Lakshadweep.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Minicoy North Lighthouse, Minicoy Island, UT of Lakshadweep
sites.work: Special repairs and maintenance of lighthouse tower and compound wall etc.

scope.item: Special repairs and maintenance of Lighthouse Tower and compound wall etc.

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME certificate) and technical documents to reach the office by post or in person before the deadline. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies, OR for contractors from Lakshadweep islands, work experience with any Government department in island works during last 7 years
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40%, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel
Unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure V), tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV), not-blacklisted affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper (Annexure VIII), relatives list (Annexure VII)
CA-certified average annual turnover of last three years
notes: NIT dated 02.01.2023; two-cover online bids. Download/submission 04.01.2023 11:00 to 24.01.2023 15:00; queries by 16.01.2023 12:00; EMD original by 23.01.2023 15:00; technical bid opening 25.01.2023 15:00. Section I only (pages numbered 2-4); no BOQ.
